decisions.reason: Documented customer savings and continued website presence indicate that this modular concept has shown value, so a growing German machinery firm would likely keep it and face only a low drop risk.
Because it has remained on its own page since launch and is close to the core portfolio, management would treat it as a relatively low-cost option worth keeping while market uptake becomes clearer.
A named customer investment and quantified annual savings substantially reduce uncertainty around this concept, making continued market presence the more likely choice.
As a very recent 2024 launch in a familiar product area, it is still an option with unresolved upside and limited reason for immediate abandonment.

This 2024 adjacent innovation fits the firm's strategic direction and should be kept on the market for further learning, though its newer and less proven status makes drop risk somewhat higher than for the older launches.
